<!-- Shared feedback helpers for every exercise page. Include this after _gradethis.qmd. -->

```{webr}
#| edit: false
#| output: false
#| include: false

# Tips on tidyverse style. Returns a sentence, or NULL when there is nothing to say.
# Checks call this and add the tip to their feedback, so students hear it even when the answer is right.
style_tip <- function(code) {
  code <- paste(code, collapse = "\n")
  has <- function(pattern) grepl(pattern, code, perl = TRUE)
  if (has("%>%")) {
    return("Tip: this class uses the native pipe `|>` rather than `%>%`. They work the same here.")
  }
  if (has("\\w+\\$\\w+")) {
    return("Tip: instead of `data$column`, try working inside a pipeline, e.g. `crime |> summarise(...)` or `crime |> pull(column)`.")
  }
  if (has("\\[[^\\]]*,")) {
    return("Tip: square-bracket indexing like `crime[rows, cols]` works, but `filter()` and `select()` are easier to read.")
  }
  if (has("\\b(aggregate|tapply|subset)\\(")) {
    return("Tip: `group_by()` plus `summarise()` is the tidyverse way to do this, and reads more clearly.")
  }
  NULL
}

# Pass with an optional style tip appended. `{...}` in `msg` is filled in from the check's variables.
pass_with_tip <- function(msg, code, env = parent.frame()) {
  msg <- glue::glue(msg, .envir = env)
  tip <- style_tip(code)
  gradethis::pass(if (is.null(tip)) msg else paste(msg, tip), env = env)
}

# TRUE when every value in `target` shows up in some numeric column of `res`.
# Lets students name their summary columns whatever they like.
has_values <- function(res, target) {
  if (!is.data.frame(res)) return(FALSE)
  target <- sort(round(as.numeric(target), 4))
  any(vapply(res, function(col) {
    is.numeric(col) && length(col) == length(target) &&
      isTRUE(all.equal(sort(round(col, 4)), target))
  }, logical(1)))
}
```
